Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT BHU is 11th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT BHU in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a First Class in BE/B.Tech. and M.Tech. in Civil Engineering with a minimum of 60% marks or 6.0 CPI, and GATE qualification is mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 28 years, with age relaxation applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 37000 Per Month, along with HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply by sending their complete application along with required documents via email before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at IIT BHU is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT BHU located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Banaras Hindu University (IIT BHU) is located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 221005.
